name: Automation of manual freight forwarding, warehouse and customs paperwork processes
summary: Fictional manual steps between orders, warehouses and customs portals replaced by dependable tools.
audience: Fictional freight forwarders and warehouse operators whose clerks retype the same data into several systems.
deliverable: A working tool, its documentation, a replay test suite and a hand-over to the team that runs it.

evidence.label: Independent research and development behind the AI engineering focus
